feeds.title: Strong Catholic Dad
feeds.description: Strong Catholic Dad exists to help fathers lead their families to heaven. Founded by Michael O'Rourke, father of 12 (two in heaven), we equip dads to grow in their own relationship with the Lord, build fulfilling relationships with their wife and kids, and pass on the Catholic Faith to their children. We help dads lead their families to heaven. We do this by providing fathers with intuitive approaches and engaging tools to grow in their own relationship with the Lord, build fulfilling relationships with their wife and kids, and pass on the Catholic Faith to their children.

feeds.title: A Catholic Dad's Perspective
feeds.description: My wife and I have been married for twenty-four years and we have four beautiful children ranging in age from seven to sixteen. I carry many titles in my life but the most important are husband and father. Everything I do and every decision I make is for my family and I am guided in these decisions by my faith. It has been a longtime goal of mine to use my love of writing to express my devotion to the Catholic faith and share my experiences as a Catholic dad. This blog features some of my Experiences and life lessons.

feeds.title: Dad Has A Blog
feeds.description: I'm a busy dad blogger who wishes he had more time to record the adventures of raising his three kids. Follow along for my occasional musings! In early December 2015, I learned the joyous news that I am a father! As a longtime blogger, journalist and social media addict, I knew that starting a daddy blog would be the best way for me to sort out my feelings on this new stage of life as well as share the adventure with family, friends and whoever else might be reading this.

feeds.title: Catholic Homeschool Dad Blog
feeds.description: Explore Catholic Dad stories, spiritual direction, tips, and resources I have picked up along the way. I am a Husband, Father and Homeschool Parent of Four Children. I taught several years of theology at the college and high school levels and woked in campus and parish ministry.

feeds.title: Catholic Husband
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Chet. This is a personal blog focused on sharing my experiences and lessons learned in the married life. I've been writing here since 2013 with Alison, my wife, serving as my editor since the very beginning. Catholic Husband covers range of topics including fatherhood, Catholic life, and careers. All of these posts have been written with the intention of helping you to love, lead, & serve your family.
